description: This class includes the dismantling of wrecks of all kinds (cars, ships, computers, etc.) for materials recovery.
includes: dismantling of automobiles, computers, televisions and other equipment for materials recovery
draining and removal of oil from discarded ships, automobiles, etc.
sorting and dismantling of non-hazardous waste, e.g. automobile wrecks for material recovery
processing of secondary raw materials: sorting and preparing for reuse
excludes: wholesale of recoverable secondary raw materials, see 4669
repair and maintenance of motor vehicles, see 4520
treatment and disposal of non-hazardous waste, see 3821
